name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Badgermole Cub's triggered mana bonus

prerequisites.timing: Whenever any creature you control is tapped for mana.
other: Badgermole Cub's oracle text: 'Whenever you tap a creature for mana, add an additional {G}.' Power is 2, so it qualifies for Delney's power-2-or-less doubling clause.

Same structural pattern as INT-0013 (Delney + Kinnan): Badgermole Cub's trigger meets CR 605.1b's criteria for a triggered mana ability (no target, triggers from a mana ability's activation, adds mana on resolution), so per CR 605.4/605.4a it resolves immediately without the stack, and Delney's extra instance (CR 603.2d) does the same.

Net effect: tapping ANY creature you control for mana adds {G}{G} (two Badgermole triggers) instead of {G}, on top of whatever mana that creature's own ability produced - a flat +2 green per creature-mana-tap, not a multiplier (same 'flat bonus per instance' shape established and corrected in INT-0013).

Stacks additively with other mana-doubling effects already in the deck (Kinnan, Enduring Vitality granting creatures a mana ability) without changing their own classification - each independent triggered/granted ability is unaffected by another's presence.
Not yet engine-reproduced this session; RULES_VERIFIED on exact Oracle text plus the same CR reasoning already engine-confirmed for the structurally identical INT-0013.

result.summary: Every tap of a creature you control for mana produces an additional {G}{G} (two Badgermole Cub triggers) instead of {G}, while both Delney and Badgermole Cub are on the battlefield.

rules_citations: CR 603.2d - an ability may state that a triggered ability triggers additional times.
CR 605.1b - criteria for a triggered ability to itself be a mana ability.
CR 605.4 / 605.4a - triggered mana abilities skip the stack and resolve immediately.
